entities.name: Kit
entities.description: A young golden wolf, companion of Lyana and child of the Cosmos Wolf Sarulf on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Lyana
entities.description: A young girl, companion of Kit.

entities.name: Lukya
entities.description: Kit's sister, a copper wolf companion of Lathril.

entities.name: Lathril
entities.description: A queen of the elves who rescued Lyana and Kit.

entities.name: Sarulf
entities.description: The immortal Cosmos Wolf, sire of Kit and Lukya.

events.summary: Draugr encounter Lyana and Kit in the woods, and one seizes Kit and carries him off.
events.quote: one of the draugr seized Kit and carried him off

events.summary: Lathril and Lukya rescue Lyana and recover Kit, who is reunited with Lyana.
events.quote: she and her companion, Kit's sister Lukya stepped in to rescue Lyana and recover Kit

events.summary: As a reward for Kit's rescue, Sarulf grants Lathril a bond between the elves of Skemfar and all wolves of Kaldheim.
events.quote: As a reward for Kit's rescue, Sarulf granted Lathril a bond

relations.quote: Kit was loyal and protective towards Lyana.
